name: Infrastructure change risk checker
problem: Parse a Terraform plan and score blast radius (deletes, IAM changes, data stores) with a PR comment.
limits: Synthetic Terraform plan JSON only; no cloud resources are accessed or changed. Rules flag destruction/replacement, IAM changes, public ingress and unknown IAM values. False-positive rate describes the fixed safe controls, not general infrastructure. evidence/findings.json explains every flag. The GitHub Action comments a seeded report on same-repository PRs; production ingestion and broader provider schemas remain Next. evidence/gate-failure.log records a destructive plan being blocked.
next: Consume uploaded real plan artifacts with secret redaction and add provider-specific risk context.
